headline: Southborough officials prepared for a Special Town Meeting on Neary School renovations and roof repairs while the regional school district approved its FY27 budget.
synopsis: Ahead of the March 2 Special Town Meeting, the Southborough School Committee detailed warrant articles proposing a $175,000 Neary School renovation feasibility study and a $6.85 million roof replacement borrowing authorization, while reiterating opposition to proposals that would close Neary. Meanwhile, the Northborough-Southborough Regional School Committee approved a $31.4 million FY27 operating budget, voting to apply $675,000 in reserves to lower town assessments. That regional budget sets Southborough's operating assessment increase at 4.83 percent, or 6.58 percent including debt and capital. The regional committee also adopted a revised 2026-2027 calendar and accepted a $50,000 state grant to update student timeout practices.

highlights.title: Neary School feasibility study and roof replacement articles
highlights.why: Officials endorsed a $175,000 feasibility study to renovate Neary and a borrowing authorization of up to $6.85 million to fix its failing roof ahead of Special Town Meeting. If the renovation study passes, the roof borrowing request will be reduced to $4.5 million.

highlights.title: Articles proposing Trottier and Finn expansions
highlights.why: School officials strongly opposed warrant articles proposing studies to close Neary and expand Trottier and Finn schools. Leaders reported that existing buildings cannot house students without major building additions or cuts to art, music, and physical education.

highlights.title: FY27 regional school operating and capital budget approval
highlights.why: The committee approved a $31,416,287 operating budget and applied $675,000 in reserve funds to offset assessments. This sets Southborough's total assessment at $10,733,409, a 6.58 percent overall increase.

highlights.title: Adoption of 2026-2027 school calendar Option 5
highlights.why: The committee voted 4-1-1 to adopt Option 5, which schedules the first day of school for September 1, 2026, and places a professional development day on Orthodox Good Friday while removing staff development days from Yom Kippur and Eid.

highlights.title: Acceptance of $50,000 state student timeout practice grant
highlights.why: The regional committee voted to accept a $50,000 state grant to provide restorative practice training and align district policies with state regulations taking effect in June 2025.
